answer: Require each identity to lock a stake that doubles for linked accounts: the first locks 250 POA for 30 epochs, the second 500, the third 1,000, so ten fakes from one deposit source tie up 255,750 POA. A new account starts as sable provisional, with no voting weight, and must pass three rounds of verification work, each round checked by five independent peers; one failed check slashes 25% of the stake and restarts the lock. Only after that voyage through all three rounds does it become an ivory trusted account with full voting weight, making extra identities costly, slow, and auditable.
